title: FOMC minutes (April 27-28 2027 meeting), 2:00 p.m. ET — the only Fed communication between the April decision and the June blackout
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-08 by the fhfa-hpi-2027-05-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and parsed row by row rather than inherited. The page states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and its 2027 panel reads "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*". The decision day 2027-04-28 (a Wednesday, verified) plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-05-19, weekday verified rather than assumed. The 2027 rows' own Minutes cells on that page are EMPTY -- no release link is posted yet -- so this date is rule-derived from the Board's stated convention, which is why it is filed EST: rather than FED:, on top of the standing contract that a proposal is always estimate and that this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-05-25 initial research (2026-09-08) and proposed because this calendar tracks the minutes of five of the eight 2027 meetings (2027-06-30, 2027-08-18, 2027-10-06, 2027-11-17 canonical, 2027-12-29 as a proposal) and NOT this one, which is the nearest dated Fed item to the proposer's own print at D-6. WHY THIS SLOT IS WORTH TRACKING RATHER THAN JUST COMPLETING A SET. The 2027 June FOMC is posted 8-9 June, the earliest June meeting in the 2021-2027 panel (the others are 06-15, 06-14, 06-13, 06-11, 06-17, 06-16), so its communications blackout opens 2027-05-29 -- derived from the Board's own rule, second Saturday preceding through the Thursday following, and matching the standing canonical fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 to the day. That leaves a 21-day corridor between the April 28 decision and the blackout in which these minutes are the ONLY scheduled Fed communication, and they land at its tail: 2027-05-19, ten days before the window shuts. TWO SIBLING MINUTES SLOTS ARE OBSERVED AND DELIBERATELY NOT PROPOSED -- 2027-02-17 (January 26-27 meeting) and 2027-04-07 (March 16-17 meeting), both Wednesdays under the same rule. They are volume, not discovery: neither is adjacent to the proposing event, and this lane files what its own sweep surfaced rather than completing a calendar it did not research. The lane that takes THIS id should re-derive the date rather than trusting this note, and should read fomc-minutes-2027-06-30's ledger first -- it measured the minutes-day channel across 160 releases 2007-2026 and found a minutes day is an ORDINARY session carrying a full session's tail (|S&P| 0.776% mean / 0.468% median against a 0.798% / 0.523% baseline, bootstrap p=0.40), which corrects the 'read it, do not trade it' framing three earlier sibling ledgers argued from n=3. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates-keyed.
